question: Should OpenClaw permit a trusted official, disabled channel plugin that declares invalid-config recovery to be loaded for doctor/setup recovery while adopting the account-owned Signal transport migration?
rationale: This PR intentionally changes both the shipped Signal configuration contract and the circumstances under which disabled plugin code may be loaded during recovery; the implementation can bound the behavior, but the permanent trust and upgrade policy requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the bounded migration
options.body: Approve the account-owned transport contract and trusted official recovery-owner predicate after confirming the intended upgrade and trust model.

options.title: Narrow the recovery seam
options.body: Keep the Signal migration but require a more constrained core recovery mechanism before allowing disabled-owner loading.

options.title: Defer the migration
options.body: Pause this branch until maintainers choose a different long-term Signal transport and recovery contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded migration
recommendation.body: Approve the account-owned transport contract and trusted official recovery-owner predicate after confirming the intended upgrade and trust model.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch history makes jesse-merhi the clearest technical routing point for explaining the intended Signal migration and recovery behavior.
